lines: Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi, shab bhar raha charcha tera.
couplets.en: Last night the moon was full, and all night there was talk of you.

lines: Kuchh ne kaha yeh chaand hai, kuchh ne kaha chehra tera.
Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi.
couplets.en: Under last night's full moon, some said it was the moon and others said it was your face.

lines: Hum bhi wahin maujood the, hum se bhi sab poochha kiye.
couplets.en: I was there too, and everyone kept asking me.

lines: Hum bhi wahin maujood the, hum se bhi sab poochha kiye.
Hum hans diye, hum chup rahe, manzoor tha parda tera.
couplets.en: They all kept asking me too, and I smiled and held my tongue to keep your secret.

lines: Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi.
couplets.en: Last night the moon was full.

lines: Is shahr mein kis se milen?
couplets.en: Who is there for me to meet in this city?

lines: Hum se to chhooti mehfilen.
Is shahr mein kis se milen, hum se to chhooti mehfilen.
couplets.en: Who is there for me to meet in this city now that my evenings in company are gone?

lines: Har shakhs tera naam le, har shakhs deewana tera.
Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi.
couplets.en: Under last night's full moon, everyone spoke your name and everyone was in love with you.

lines: Shab bhar raha charcha tera, kal chaudhvin ki raat thi.
couplets.en: All through the night of the full moon there was talk of you.

lines: Kooche ko tere chhod kar, jogi hi ban jaayen magar.
couplets.en: I could leave your lane and take to the road as a wandering ascetic.

lines: Kooche ko tere chhod kar, jogi hi ban jaayen magar.
couplets.en: I could leave your lane and take to the road as a wandering ascetic.

lines: Jangal tere, parbat tere, basti teri, sehra tera.
Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi.
couplets.en: Under last night's full moon, the forests, the mountains, the towns and the desert were all yours.

lines: Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi.
couplets.en: Last night the moon was full.

lines: Bedard, sunni ho to chal.
couplets.en: Come, heartless one, if you care to listen.

lines: Kehta hai kya achchhi ghazal.
Bedard, sunni ho to chal.
couplets.en: Come, heartless one, if you care to hear how well he recites a ghazal.

lines: Achchhi ghazal.
Aashiq tera, rusva tera.
couplets.en: A fine ghazal from your lover, disgraced for loving you.

lines: Aashiq tera, rusva tera, shayar tera, Insha tera.
Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi.
couplets.en: Under last night's full moon, Insha was yours, your lover and your poet, with all his disgrace.

lines: Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi, shab bhar raha charcha tera.
couplets.en: Last night the moon was full, and all night there was talk of you.

lines: Kuchh ne kaha yeh chaand hai, kuchh ne kaha chehra tera.
Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi.
couplets.en: Under last night's full moon, some said it was the moon and others said it was your face.
